description: Create a draft estimate with one or more options for a customer. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. The estimate is a DRAFT - it is not sent to the customer until you send it from Housecall Pro. Option blurbs and the estimate summary are set in Housecall Pro, not here. Confirm the result with hcp_get_estimate_line_items.

description.description: Line-item description/body; multi-line text is preserved

kind.description: Line item kind, e.g. "labor" or "materials" (default labor)

unit_cost_dollars.description: Your cost per unit in dollars (optional)

unit_price_dollars.description: Price per unit in DOLLARS - this server converts to Housecall Pro's integer cents for you

name: hcp_create_estimate
